compartiment: Le produit est une classe de parts du compartiment Flossbach von Storch - Multiple Opportunities II, qui fait partie du fonds d’investissement Flossbach von Storch, fonds commun de placement luxembourgeois (fonds commun de placement — FCP) de type collectif, soumis à la Partie I de la loi luxembourgeoise du 17 décembre 2010 dans sa version modifiée (Loi de 2010) et peut donc être qualifié d’OPCVM.

politique_en:
INVESTMENT STRATEGY
The Fund pursues an active investment approach. The Fund Manager can invest flexibly in the asset classes that appear attractive from his/her point of view in the respective capital market environment; the equity component is at least 25 per cent.

The basis for asset allocation is the Fund's own independent investment world view. The Fund deliberately does not follow any benchmark index. The primary objective is to generate sustainably attractive returns. Whether an individual investment is attractive is assessed within the framework of a thorough company analysis.

The risk-reward ratio is decisive for every investment decision; the potential return must clearly overcompensate for any risk of loss. The portfolio structure is based on the five guidelines of the Flossbach von Storch Pentagram diversification, quality, flexibility, solvency, and value. The composition of the portfolio is made by the Fund Manager exclusively in accordance with the criteria defined in the investment policy and is regularly reviewed and adjusted if necessary.

The investment strategy includes in-house valuation models, ESG integration, engagement, and the exercise of voting rights. In addition, exclusion criteria defined within the Sub-Fund's investment policy are taken into account. The sub-fund complies with the standards for credit quality and credit limits in the insurance industry. The Sub-Fund is categorized as an Article 8 product within the definition of the Disclosure Regulation (EU) 2019/2088 (SFDR).
